description: Canonical full-range DERA FSDS request plan for validating the frozen FRAME filing window 2020-01-01 through 2026-06-30 (ADR-077, ADR-083): 26 releases, 2020q1 through 2026q2, at the URL template empirically verified by canary run dera-fsds-canary-2020q1-20260816 (acquisition manifest sha256 7e6c44389a4299a76737533cc3144404b5a50354649467adc327272ccc3234d6, raw ZIP sha256 48ed9834c66d565c21130d087eae941b25770e2d7cc8351d17652612289fcd67, extracted sub sha256 5c89b0295c403903909c34b9293d9a050f589b0722585f3ee6d6035b16501950, 5,817 lines). No 2026q3 buffer release is included: it is not currently acquirable for this freeze window (its quarter is incomplete), and a successor plan may add it later only if real validation shows late-June edge clustering. Possessing this plan does not authorize a live request; the full acquisition remains separately authorized. DERA is an independent FRAME validation source only, never eligibility or universe input (ADR-081).
observed_through_basis: EDGAR's published acceptance rule assigns a filing date no earlier than the acceptance day (post-5:30 p.m. ET acceptances receive the next business day's filing date), so the 2020q1-2026q2 release union spans every in-window filed date. The residual risk is dataset-cut slippage of late-June 2026 filings into the unpublished 2026q3 release, which is operationally possible but not derivable from published rules. Noncoverage is non-gating (ADR-081); if the full validation shows late-June edge clustering, a successor plan revisits this value and/or adds 2026q3 (ADR-083).
